assertion.statement: For the actual final primitive D210 form and R, its level satisfies N≤210^300 R^2 and rad(N) divides R.
assertion.objects: The same r_ell and primitive f, E=L(A[11]), the kernel field Q(chi), and the quadratic-kernel extension Fprime of their compositum.
assertion.hypotheses: E/Q is Galois with degree<2^66 and A has good reduction over E at2,3,5,7; chi is tame at odd primes with2-part conductor at most4; b restricts quadratically and normally as stated; actual local conductor equals v_p(N). Ramification/different and Artin conductor conventions are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every rational p using an auxiliary ell different from p for the actual family.
assertion.parameter_range: Small primes2,3,5,7 and all p>7; no bound on the full tame ramification index is assumed.
assertion.uniformity: Bounds use only R and the fixed degree/character constraints, not a bounded coefficient-field degree.
assertion.constants: v_p(e_Fprime)≤65 for3,5,7 and≤67 for2; largest positive upper break≤136; Swan≤272; total conductor≤274<300 at small primes,≤2 above7 and0 outside support.
assertion.normalizations: Q(chi) is its kernel field, not value field. Full conductor includes tame and Swan terms without semisimplifying inertia.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Unbounded tame ramification is allowed. Separate torsion good reduction and prime-to11 isogeny argument establish the required Galois E; this connection does not assume them proved merely from the degree estimate.
assertion.limit_order: Construct E and the normal splitting extensions; bound wild p-part indices and upper breaks; bound the actual conductor; transfer to level via the all-prime comparison.
